cohesive_variety_thornroot_thicket.name: Thornroot Thicket
cohesive_variety_thornroot_thicket.description: Thornroot Thicket is impassable scenery used for the blocked body cells of generated RMG obstacles. It cannot be visited, collected or cleared and grants no resources. Its appearance is chosen deterministically in grasslands, deep forest.
